title: Now Sin, with Reign Unbroken
description: Now Sin, with Reign Unbroken in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 4 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Thomas Hansen Kingo, first published in 1699. The English translation is by Paul Christian Paulsen (1927). The tune, AU MEINES HERZENS GRUNDE, is by David Wolder (1598). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: Now sin with reign un_-bro-ken, no more can rule my life, Since God the Word hath_ spo-ken, That wins for me the strife; Bap-tized, re-born by grace I_ am re-deem'd from e-vil, And have re-nounced the de-vil and all his works and ways.

lines: no more can rule my life,
Since God the Word hath spoken,
That wins for me the strife;
and all his works and ways.
I turn to that in glee?
My Life, my Light, my Way.
My home, my hope, my God.
Oh help me not to waver,
Help me to hate all sin,
The crown of life to win.
